This feature improves price visibility for both cashiers and customers, making transactions more transparent and efficient. The POS Product Price Display (With/Without Tax) module enhances the Odoo Point of Sale system by providing full control over how product prices are displayed on the POS interface. With this app, businesses can easily configure whether product prices should be shown including tax or excluding tax, based on their operational or regional requirements. This feature is particularly useful for businesses that serve both B2C (Business-to-Consumer) and B2B (Business-to-Business) customers, where price presentation preferences differ. Retailers can display tax-inclusive prices for customer-facing sales, while wholesalers can show tax-exclusive prices for trade transactions. On the POS interface, each product card dynamically shows the price according to the selected mode, clearly labeled as either “With Tax” or “Without Tax.” This helps cashiers and customers instantly identify the accurate selling price, ensuring transparency and avoiding confusion during checkout.
